# Domain Decoded

> Domain Decoded is the site of Imteaz (Galib) Chowdhury, a domain investor, naming strategist, brand builder and LinkedIn ghostwriter based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It lists trademark-cleared, comparable-sales-verified premium .COM domains and offers two services: domain naming and brokerage, and LinkedIn ghostwriting. Every domain is screened with DIOS (Domain Investing Operating System), a five-stage due-diligence process, before it is listed.

Site languages: English, Arabic (العربية), Mandarin Chinese (中文), Spanish (Español). Each page has a translated version with the suffix -ar, -zh or -es (for example services-ar.html).

## Main pages
- [Home and portfolio](https://galibsjournal.com/): premium .COM domains for sale with trademark, history and comparable-sales checks
- [Services and pricing](https://galibsjournal.com/services.html): LinkedIn ghostwriting plans and domain naming, brokerage and audit pricing, with payment details
- [About Imteaz (Galib) Chowdhury](https://galibsjournal.com/about.html): who runs the site, how domains are sourced, vetted, named and brokered, the LinkedIn ghostwriting service, his writing for CircleID and the APNIC Blog, and how to get in touch
- [FAQ](https://galibsjournal.com/faq.html): answers on LinkedIn ghostwriting, domain buying, trademark clearance, UDRP history, valuation, brokerage, pricing and payment
- [DIOS due-diligence workflow](https://galibsjournal.com/workflow.html): the five-stage process behind every listing
- [Why it matters to founders](https://galibsjournal.com/why-it-matters.html): why the names rejected during due diligence matter more than the one chosen, covering trademark conflicts, hidden domain history, data-backed pricing and global scalability
- [Blog](https://galibsjournal.com/blog.html): articles on domain pricing, trademark screening, naming and new gTLDs
- [Contact](https://galibsjournal.com/contact.html)

## Blog articles (full text on the site)
- [Why This Domain Sits at $3,000-$4,500, Not $10,000](https://galibsjournal.com/blog-post-juronix-pricing-comps.html): comps-based domain pricing, using Juronix.com as the worked example
- [Why "Meaningless" Brand Names Built Billion-Dollar Companies](https://galibsjournal.com/blog-post-meaningless-brand-names.html): coined names such as Kodak, Xerox and Audi, and why the trick is riskier today
- [The Grief Market Nobody Likes to Talk About](https://galibsjournal.com/blog-post-grief-market.html): market numbers for grief-tech and three matching .com domains
- [The TLD Fight Is On: 1,615 Applications, and One Question Nobody Is Asking](https://galibsjournal.com/blog-post-tld-fight-circleid.html): ICANN's 2026 new-gTLD round (originally on CircleID)
- [TLDFight: Who Wins When 1,615 Applications Collide?](https://galibsjournal.com/blog-post-tldfight-linkedin.html): a shorter plain-English version of the same topic
